sections.content: To talk about going and coming, use 'megy' (goes) and 'jön' (comes). These show action and often take a destination with -ba/-be.

items.english: After that we go to school.

items.spanish: A találkozó után együtt megyünk haza.
items.english: After the meeting we go home together.

sections.content: 'Haza' (home) is an adverb destination word; it does not take -ba/-be. Use 'velünk' (with us) to say 'comes with us'.
